messages:
sara_ml: heads-up — bringing up a new compact multilingual embed (m-compact-v2) on staging. initial recall/cluster numbers look off compared to prod, esp for short queries and non-en languages. posting quick snapshot below, anyories?

ben_platform: saw similar in the microbench. recall@1 dipped on our short-tail testset (~<20 tokens). noticed more nearest-neighbor swaps for spanish/jp samples.

kai_research: ran a quick clustering + silhouette run on the staging vectors. silhouette dropped and intra-cluster variance up. numbers: 
```
prod (m-compact-v1): recall@1=0.72, recall@10=0.91, silhouette=0.22
m-compact-v2 (staging): recall@1=0.65, recall@10=0.86, silhouette=0.14
```
looks like margin compression after quant/config changes.

luis_eval: also ran holdout K-fold (k=5) on cross-ling holdout. per-lang recall delta: en:-0.03, es:-0.08, ja:-0.09, fr:-0.04. precision at 1 drops more for short queries. attaching small sample of failure pairs: 
```
query: "cómo reiniciar contraseña" -> expected doc A, got doc B (similar lexical overlap but semantically different)
query: "ログインできない" -> expected doc X, got doc Y (embedding collapsed with unrelated UI messages)
```

sara_ml: thanks — variant bring-up steps: we changed quant backend to aggressive per-tensor int4 config + new layernorm folding. could be calibration.

ben_platform: data/ops note: HNSW index params on staging are identical to prod (M=32, ef_construction=200). indexing not likely culprit but we should confirm vector norms and scaling.

kai_research: hypothesis list: 1) post-quant scale mismatch across channels 2) fold+fused layernorm changes alter geometry 3) training dropout->float-behavior mismatch when compressing to int4. Quick tests to run: per-channel re-calib (minmax vs KL), disable folding layernorm, and small-batch eval with L2-normalization enforced.

luis_eval: i can run per-channel KL calibration sweep (3 seeds) and output recall distribs. ETA ~2h. which holdout to use? recommend: short-query holdout (3k), multilingual holdout (5k), and production random sample (10k).

eva_ops: @luis_eval nod. tagging infra: staging GPU pool will be free in ~30m, i'll reserve. also enabling higher logging for the vector pipeline (sample IDs) for ~3h. :thumbsup:

kai_research: quick command I used for silhouette: 
```bash
python eval/cluster_metrics.py --vectors staging/mcompactv2 --holdout holdouts/multilang_short --metric silhouette --out /tmp/sil.csv
```
if anyone wants the script i'll paste it.

sara_ml: action items: 
- @luis_eval run per-channel KL calibration + minmax baseline and post results (recall@1/5/10, silhouette, nn-swap rate)
- @kai_research run layernorm-fold ablation and report geometry plots (UMAP + pairwise angle hist)
- @ben_platform confirm index config + run a vector-norm check across prod vs staging (dump histograms)
- @eva_ops reserve staging and enable verbose sampling logs

deploy-bot: staging deploy m-compact-v2 completed at 2026-03-23T15:04:12Z (sha: a1b2c3d).

luis_eval: starting sweep now, will post results in this thread when done.

sara_ml: thanks team — prioritize short-query recall fixes; if per-channel calibration recovers >0.03 recall@1 on es/ja we can iterate. otherwise we may rollback the fold change and re-evaluate.

ben_platform: noted. i'll check rollout gating rule (recall delta threshold) and hold off any canary until we have the calibs.

kai_research: ping me if you want the quick UMAP notebook, i've got pre-made plots that highlight cluster leakage.

(ends)
